item.title: Time Sensitive Networking and Tactile Cyber-Physical Systems
item.description: Objective Design and implementation of a Tactile Cyber-Physical System for real-time interaction between physical and virtual worlds for applications requiring ultra-reliable low latency communication (uRLLC). To develop TSN enabled ethernet switches on programmable network hardware (Netronome Agilio SmartNIC) using P4 programmikng language. To implement time synchronization in the network and then setup a TSN network. This involves implementing time aware shaper and gate control list at the switch ports.
